title: Tide official Go component callback request / 1
$comment: UTF-8 JSON lines on inherited Unix stream FD. At most 256 KiB excluding LF; no caller identity fields. Replies: {id,data? ,error?:{code,message}}. IDs increase per connection; $cancel reuses a pending id. Invocation arguments follow call.schema.json. Actual caller and deadline are bound by the host. development is reserved for ai-panel and a host-bound project task; params={tool,args}. No caller-supplied project or permission fields.
